business_scope.primary_industry_name: Chemical Fractionation of Low-Molecular-Weight Heparin Crude

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands - Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC) Regime
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - U.S.-derived common law corporate statutes (Business Corporations Act 1990) combined with Marshallese customary law and a unitary national court system
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the United States and the Republic of the Marshall Islands (economic and investment provisions, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
South Pacific Regional Trade and Economic Cooperation Agreement (SPARTECA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2012 (as amended by the 2021 Amendment); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Regulations 2021; Business Corporations Act 1990, Sections 43-45, 49-50 and 91 (share registers, registered agents and corporate records); Banking Act 1991; obligations arising from membership in the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) and the Global Forum on Transparency and Exchange of Information for Tax Purposes.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director, shareholder and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority or notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the preceding 90 days)
Bank reference letter addressing creditworthiness and conduct of account
Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, memorandum and articles of association for each corporate shareholder or corporate director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry of the entity's domicile

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized consent to act as director and certified register of directors and shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members and close associates; automated and manual screening against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, U.S. OFAC SDN list including the 50-percent ownership rule and sectoral sanctions, UK/EU asset-freeze lists, and RMI Financial Intelligence Unit domestic designations; full negative-news screening and independent source-of-wealth verification required for the Medium_Risk_Enhanced pharmaceutical-extraction tier; all screening results must be archived for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Companies Registry - Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Majuro (all filings submitted through licensed registered agents using the RMI Online Registry System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in Latin script and are normally registered in English; the registry imposes no Marshallese transliteration requirement, but the chosen name must be distinguishable upon the register and must not imply governmental sponsorship or an unlicensed regulated activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a formal rejection, the licensed registered agent receives the Registrar's written refusal through the Online Registry System. The applicant may file an administrative reconsideration request through the registered agent within 14 business days, attaching a new or amended name and a legal brief on distinguishability and statutory compliance. If the reconsideration is denied, the applicant may either submit a different name reservation or petition the RMI High Court for judicial review within 21 days of the denial. A successful reservation may be extended only upon payment of the standard government extension fee and before expiry of the initial 30-day window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted - the statutory registered office may be the principal address of the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent; a non-resident Business Corporation is not required to lease physical premises, employ local staff, maintain tangible assets, or keep a local bank account in the RMI, even where the commercial substance of the business (chemical fractionation of low-molecular-weight heparin crude) is conducted entirely abroad.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - quantified at less than 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar or the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit; any on-site verification would normally be directed at the licensed registered agent's office rather than the corporation's foreign operational facilities, but UBO records and corporate registers must nonetheless be immediately producible at the registered office.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation - government fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Companies Registry (Office of the Registrar of Corporations)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of incorporation - filing fee for standard authorized capital
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Companies Registry (Office of the Registrar of Corporations)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year annual registration and franchise tax
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Ministry of Finance / National Treasury

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office retainer (first year, including UBO records maintenance and statutory correspondence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed RMI registered agent (private corporate service provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of the due-diligence documentation bundle (five documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and RMI diplomatic/consular post (Majuro or foreign consulate)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and international sanctions screening (two directors, one UBO, one corporate shareholder) via global watchlist databases
Expedited courier and consular transmission (registered agent to Majuro and consular post)
Certified English translation of non-English corporate or personal documents (if applicable)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, 31 Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC) Chapter 1, Sections 102-104 (Certificate of Incorporation), Sections 51-53 (Registered Agent), Section 30 (Directors and Officers), Section 17 (General Corporate Powers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Marshall Islands Business Registry Division, Office of the Attorney General, Registrar of Corporations
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Certificate of Incorporation) under Form Co-1
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the Business Corporation may issue shares with or without par value, and capital may be contributed in cash, promissory notes, or property. No escrow account requirement applies to non-resident tax-exempt corporations under 31 MIRC Ch.1.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that this Corporation confirms the execution and due filing of its Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry Division, and adopts the Bylaws as presented. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office located at the address of the licensed registered agent in Majuro shall be and remain the statutory registered office, and said agent is appointed as agent for service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the subscribers' share subscriptions set forth in the subscription lists are accepted, all shares are issued for lawful consideration, and the issuance is recorded in the capital accounts. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the persons named are elected directors, and the President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed officers with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and obtain all licenses necessary for the heparin fractionation business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Business Registry Division via online portal or authorized registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request verifying the proposed corporate name is distinguishable on the registry index; pay the reservation fee; receive a Name Clearance Certificate valid for 30 days; then proceed to draft the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity of the incorporator
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for duplication or similarity, file a written objection or submit two alternate names for re-screening within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Business Registry Division / approved notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation stating corporate name, registered agent, director list, share structure, and purpose clause covering chemical fractionation activities; have each incorporator execute and notarize the document with apostille certification where required.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as registered agent from the licensed agent
Certified copy of the incorporator's passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is queried for incomplete information, cure by filing an amendment or supplementary affidavit within 10 business days of the deficiency notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles of Incorporation and Payment of State Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar together with the $500 filing fee; obtain a stamped filing receipt; the Registrar reviews for statutory compliance under 31 MIRC Ch.1.
required_dossiers: Cover letter confirming non-resident tax-exempt status election
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect letter, file an amended Article within 14 days; if the filing lapses, refile with a late-filing penalty waiver request supported by an explanation affidavit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Business Registry Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, request certified true copies of the Certificate of Incorporation and the endorsed Articles; verify that the certificate bears the seal of the Registrar and the date of incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, submit a formal rectification request with the original certificate within 7 business days for re-issuance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and Initial Corporate Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporation's board of directors / Corporate Secretariat
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or execute unanimous written consents adopting the Bylaws, electing directors, appointing officers, accepting share subscriptions, and recording the registered office; maintain minutes in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: First board resolution or written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If records are challenged by the Registrar, correct by filing a unanimous written consent retroactively confirming all board actions with dated signatures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Annual Franchise Tax and Business License Coordination
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Business Registry Division and Ministry of Finance, Business License Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the annual franchise tax to maintain active status; obtain the general business license application for the non-resident tax-exempt entity; attach the Certificate of Incorporation and the approved pharmaceutical manufacturing license where physical operations are contemplated in-country.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual fee is paid late, apply for a late-filing amnesty or reinstatement under the Registrar's reinstatement procedure with payment of the prescribed penalty.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Ministry of Health and Human Services, Pharmaceutical Regulatory Section; Ministry of Finance, Business License Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Repacking License under the Pharmacy and Drugs Act 1994 and Business License Act 1988

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report required under the Environmental Protection Act (Cap. 77) for chemical processing and pharmaceutical extraction facilities discharging process waste; Category A activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Effluent discharge limits: pH 6.0-9.0, BOD5 not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 10 mg/L; VOC emission controls under the Clean Air regulations; waste handling and disposal protocols for spent solvents and heparin extraction residues under hazardous waste management rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Marshall Islands Fire Safety Inspectorate confirming compliance with fire suppression and egress requirements; structural load inspection certification for chemical processing areas; and occupational health clearance under the Workplace Injury Compensation Act and Occupational Safety regulations including chemical hygiene plans and emergency response protocols.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services – Revenue and Taxation Division (RMI Tax and Revenue Office), Majuro. Corporate registry: Office of the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act 1990, fileable only through a statutorily licensed registered agent; no consolidated public tax e-portal exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: The foreign shareholder appoints a licensed RMI registered agent and files the Articles of Incorporation; the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation (corporate number) as the primary entity identifier. Step 2: No statutory TIN is required for a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation because its foreign-source heparin fractionation and export sales are outside the RMI tax base. Step 3: If the BC elects resident status or employs RMI-resident staff, it files Form TR-1 with the Revenue and Taxation Division to obtain a TIN and employer registration. Step 4: For physical shipments, the BC obtains an annual Importer/Exporter License from RMI Customs. Step 5: For letter-of-credit and SWIFT wire rails, the BC presents the Certificate of Incorporation, certificate of good standing, and beneficial-ownership extract to the collecting bank.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Non-Resident Domestic Corporation. Taxation is strictly territorial; income derived outside the RMI, including the extraction, fractionation, and export of heparin sodium crude, is wholly exempt from corporate income, capital gains, dividend, and withholding taxes. No minimum tax and no capital duty.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in RMI law. Available statutory elections: (i) status election between Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (default, fully tax-exempt) and Resident Domestic Corporation (taxable at 3% on RMI-source business income), made by charter provision and notified to the Tax and Revenue Division; (ii) continuance/redomiciliation election under Part IX of the Business Corporations Act, tax-neutral in the RMI; (iii) branch-versus-subsidiary election for foreign holdings, immaterial because the RMI has no CFC, Subpart-F, or participation-exemption rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or Sales/Use Tax. The RMI levies only Customs Import Duties and selected commodity excises under the Customs Tariff Act 2006; export goods are duty-exempt by statute.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST threshold exists. Customs registration via an annual Importer/Exporter License (USD 100–500) is required for physical consignments; crude heparin sodium as a biologic/pharmaceutical input may also require a Ministry of Health import/export permit at the RMI port of call.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None — the RMI imposes no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based tax reporting. Customs clearance uses paper declarations supported by electronic carrier manifests. The BC must retain ERP-generated commercial invoices, packing lists, and transport documents for customs audit and banking AML review.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable under a VAT framework: the RMI levies no VAT, and exports are outside the scope of RMI indirect taxation by the territorial rule rather than by a zero-rating mechanism. Export of heparin sodium crude (ISIC 3250) bears a 0% RMI duty/tax rate; no refund mechanism exists because no input VAT is incurred. Duty-free import of machinery or chemical feedstocks, if used in RMI territory, would require a Customs Duty Exemption Certificate for manufacturing inputs. No statutory FX-control or repatriation deadline applies (USD is legal tender); the 180-day benchmark is a banking documentary expectation for LC/SWIFT collections.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration approved by RMI Customs Service
Commercial Invoice (straight bill; ISIC 3250 description and value)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Ministry of Health permit for biologic/pharmaceutical raw material if transshipped through RMI ports
Certificate of Origin (optional, supporting consignee tariff preferences)
Beneficial-ownership extract (supporting LC/SWIFT payment rails and AML due diligence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Not applicable to VAT zero-rating fraud because no VAT exists. Residual exposure: false export declarations under the RMI Customs and Excise Regulations trigger forfeiture of goods, penalties up to 100% of evaded duty, fines up to USD 10,000 and/or imprisonment up to 5 years. Presenting false trade documents to a bank constitutes a financial crime under RMI criminal and anti-money-laundering legislation, exposing the BC to license revocation, registry debarment, and director liability. The Revenue and Taxation Division applies a five-year record-retention period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commissioner, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). No central bank is established; the U.S. dollar is the sole legal tender, and the U.S. Federal Reserve's monetary policy effectively governs the currency supply.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI has no separate national currency and imposes no exchange control regime. Capital and current account transactions are freely convertible as the U.S. dollar is both the domestic and settlement currency. Profit remittance and dividend distributions to non-resident shareholders are not subject to statutory approval or conversion hurdles; however, all wire transfers must satisfy the AML/CFT reporting thresholds under the RMI Banking Act 1991, as amended, and the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2019.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are no statutory export proceeds surrender rules, no mandatory conversion ratios, and no repatriation deadlines for export receipts. Exporters may retain U.S. dollar proceeds in any licensed RMI bank or offshore account, subject only to record-keeping and suspicious transaction reporting requirements.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Operating Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account and Trade Finance Settlement Account
Specialized Project Escrow and Guarantee Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. The RMI does not maintain a dedicated fintech or electronic money institution (EMI) licensing framework. Offshore digital payment platforms may only hold cleared funds through a licensed RMI bank or a recognized U.S. correspondent, and domestic banks generally reject client relationships with unlicensed EMIs due to correspondent banking de-risking pressures. Any cross-border EMI arrangement would require a written sponsorship agreement with an RMI-licensed bank and full look-through access to the EMI's transaction monitoring logs.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one director and one senior executive, plus all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) with 10% or greater ownership, is mandatory for the initial corporate account opening interview. Remote onboarding is permitted only for existing banking relationships with the same UBO profile and only after a local notarized power-of-attorney is filed with the bank; foreign-issued certified copies must be legalized by apostille or through the RMI Consulate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no physical office or employees in RMI
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified articles of incorporation, current certificate of good standing, foreign qualification certificate in the jurisdiction of operations, registered agent confirmation from the RMI Registered Agent, a detailed ownership and control chart, and corporate resolution approving the banking relationship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sensitive industry exposure (ISIC 3250 pharmaceutical chemical fractionation)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Statutory License under the Pharmacy and Controlled Substances Act, Good Manufacturing Practice certificate, import/export permits from counterparty customs authorities, Material Safety Data Sheets, source documentation for heparin crude procurement, and a product liability insurance certificate mirroring the anticipated transaction volume.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-risk jurisdiction or cross-border counterparty in a tax haven or high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substantial economic activity evidence (lease agreements, payroll records, sub-processing contracts), sanctions screening results (OFAC, EU, UN), clear counterparty corporate registry extract, and a transaction rationale memorandum explaining the physical flow of heparin crude to API and finished product.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity in a newly opened Operational USD account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Cash-flow forecast prepared by a licensed CPA, signed supply agreements with end-buyers, valid pro-forma invoices, customs declarations, bill of lading template, and a standing order of documentary evidence to be provided within 5 banking days of any transaction exceeding USD 50,000.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions from the parent entity or foreign investors must be remitted in U.S. dollars via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for U.S.-domestic transfers) to the RMI-licensed bank's operational account. The beneficiary reference must include 'SHAREHOLDER CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION – MH-BC' and must be accompanied by: (a) board resolution approval of the capital injection, (b) subscription ledger, (c) source-of-funds declaration, and (d) a copy of the share issuance certificate. The applicable payment purpose code under ISO 20022/legacy SWIFT is '110' (Capital transfers) or the bank-specific purpose code for equity investment; for goods-related prepayment, use 'C11' or 'PURP' fields specifying equity injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for heparin crude procurement and toll manufacturing are executed primarily through: (1) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfer for open-account settlements where the invoice amount is below USD 250,000, with the purpose code 'P11' or 'F01' for trade settlement; (2) Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) issued by the RMI bank's correspondent network, typically a U.S. money-center bank, as irrevocable documentary credits covering the import of crude heparin from licensed slaughterhouses and fractionation subcontractors; (3) Documentary collections (D/P or D/A) for intermediate risk mitigation. All outbound transfers require a copy of the underlying invoice, transport document, and a customs-validated export declaration when the payment triggers an import into the final destination country.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR forwards for European API buyers and equipment imports (tenor up to 12 months)
Deliverable USD/JPY forwards for Japanese heparin procurement and distribution contracts (tenor up to 6 months)
Offshore USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for Chinese supplier settlements involving Renminbi-denominated contracts
Cross-currency swaps (USD vs. EUR or USD vs. CNY) for multi-year toll manufacturing agreements exceeding USD 5 million in notional value
Plain vanilla USD interest rate swaps for long-term capital project funding, if local banks extend credit facilities

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Report (Business Corporations Act, Section 106)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Business Entities Division, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed via the licensed Marshall Islands registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between January 1 and November 30; hard deadline November 30 of each calendar year (not tied to the incorporation anniversary)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: US$100 late fee assessed immediately after November 30; continuation of default past the 60-day notice period permits administrative strike-off by the Registrar; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears plus reinstatement fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent, with onward central UBO filing to the Registrar of Corporations under the RMI beneficial ownership regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation concurrent with the Annual Corporate Report cycle (by November 30); event-driven UBO refresh required within 30 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offence for the corporation and the registered agent; statutory fines up to US$25,000, disqualification of the agent, and potential deregistration of the corporation for non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent appointed under the Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the renewal date of the agent engagement, typically aligned with the November 30 annual report deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent resignation triggers a 30-day obligation to appoint a replacement; failure to maintain a statutory registered agent and registered office in the Marshall Islands results in administrative dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No automatic statutory audit applies to this non-resident Business Corporation. An independent audit becomes compulsory if: (i) required by the articles of incorporation or bylaws; (ii) demanded in writing by shareholders holding at least 10% of the issued shares; (iii) mandated by a sectoral license (banking, insurance, trust); or (iv) the corporation is listed on an exchange. For the ISIC 3250 heparin extraction entity, certified audits are normally demanded by lenders, GMP/EMA inspectors, and pharmaceutical counterparties as a commercial condition, but not by RMI corporate statute.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No RMI domestic GAAP codification exists for Business Corporations; financial statements must be prepared under IFRS (recommended) or US GAAP. The Business Corporations Act requires the board to maintain accounting records sufficient to accurately explain transactions and disclose the corporation's financial position with reasonable accuracy.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain and maintain a current beneficial ownership register for the corporation. A UBO declaration is collected at onboarding, re-confirmed annually in the corporate annual report cycle, and refreshed within 30 days of any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership. The registered agent submits consolidated UBO data to the Registrar's central register; omission or false certification constitutes an offence under the RMI beneficial ownership rules.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% effective for a non-resident domestic Business Corporation (BC) on foreign-source income. The nominal corporate schedule of the RMI Income Tax Act (Title 54 MIRC) reaches a maximum of 32%, but the charge attaches only to income derived from sources within the Marshall Islands, which a non-resident BC conducting zero RMI business does not derive.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption for non-resident domestic BCs on all foreign-source income; no capital gains tax; no VAT or sales tax; no estate, inheritance, or gift tax; no payroll tax on foreign employees. The 3% Gross Revenue Tax (Title 54, Chapter 5 MIRC) applies only to gross revenue for services rendered or business carried on inside the RMI and is therefore inapplicable to an offshore heparin-fractionation trading structure operated entirely outside the RMI. The only recurring state charge is the flat annual franchise tax with the Registrar of Corporations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Business Corporations Act (31 MIRC) Annual Report and Franchise Tax Return; filed electronically through the RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations e-filing portal (registered-agent mediated).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before 30 April of each calendar year for calendar-year filers; for corporations with a non-calendar fiscal year, the report is due within six months after the end of the fiscal year. Filing is mandatory irrespective of income level; the franchise tax is a flat pre-payment, not an income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name and any alternate name used in the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name from the Certificate of Incorporation; do not add foreign trade names without prior Registrar approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and RMI street address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be an active RMI-licensed registered agent; a P.O. box alone is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital: number of classes, number of shares, and par value per class.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Franchise tier is computed on total authorized shares; declare accurately to avoid underpayment of the annual fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: full legal names, residential addresses, and nationalities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be natural persons of any nationality; nominee directors are permitted but the beneficial owner must be disclosed to the registered agent under AML/CFT obligations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of status as a non-resident domestic corporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Check the box confirming the corporation does not carry on business in the RMI; this election preserves the 0% RMI income tax treatment.
Calendar-year end (31 December) is standard; an off-calendar year-end shifts the annual report due date to six months after such year-end.
Tiered flat fee: USD 100 for up to 10,000 authorized shares; USD 200 for 10,001-100,000; USD 250 for 100,001-1,000,000; USD 350 for more than 1,000,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and verification by a director, officer, or authorized agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Signed under penalty of perjury; foreign-based directors may sign electronically through the registered agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge on the franchise fee, loss of the Registrar's Certificate of Good Standing, and administrative strike-off or revocation of the corporate charter for persistent default; reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, penalties, and restoration fees. Continued trading after strike-off renders corporate acts voidable and exposes directors to personal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Corporate Income Tax Return (Income Tax Act Section 238), filed with the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office, Ministry of Finance.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return is due on the 15th day of the fourth month following the close of the taxable year (calendar-year taxpayers: 15 April). Quarterly instalments are required only where the corporation derives RMI-source income. A non-resident domestic BC deriving no RMI-source income has no filing obligation and should not file a nil return absent a specific demand from the Revenue and Taxation Officer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from sources within the Marshall Islands.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter zero for a non-resident BC that performs all fractionation, storage, and sales activities outside the RMI.
Foreign-source income is exempt; if a return is compelled, report such income only in a memo schedule with the statutory exemption citation.
No deduction is necessary when taxable RMI-source income is zero; expense allocation schedules unnecessarily trigger audit scrutiny.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of tax due at applicable rates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Effective rate is 0%; do not self-assess tax on foreign income.
If no return is required, the safest compliance position is a board resolution documenting the non-resident status and the absence of RMI-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file a required return triggers statutory penalties including interest on any assessed tax, a late-filing penalty of up to 25% of the tax due, and criminal sanctions for willful failure. For the standard non-resident BC, the operative risk is not the income tax return but the annual report/franchise tax default described above.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions to foreign shareholders of a non-resident domestic BC.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No double taxation agreement (DTA) exists between the RMI and any State. The RMI is party only to Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs, e.g., with the United States). Treaty relief is therefore unavailable; the practical protocol is: (1) obtain the RMI Registrar's Certificate of Good Standing; (2) obtain a notarized letter from the registered agent confirming the corporation's non-resident domestic status and absence of RMI tax liability; (3) if a foreign withholding agent demands, obtain a letter from the RMI Ministry of Finance confirming that the BC is not an RMI tax resident and that no RMI withholding tax applies to dividends; (4) submit the corporate charter, annual report receipt, and beneficial-ownership attestation to the paying bank and the foreign tax authority; and (5) do not present any document styled as an RMI 'Tax Residency Certificate' because the RMI does not issue one — the BC is a non-resident for RMI tax purposes, and fabrication of such a certificate is a criminal offence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% for royalties and interest paid to non-residents; no treaty rate is applicable because the RMI has no DTA network. RMI law does not distinguish between related-party and arm's-length payments for withholding purposes, and no RMI source tax attaches to IP royalties or debt interest paid by a non-resident BC from foreign-source funds.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — the RMI has no transfer-pricing legislation, no Local File or Master File requirements, and no statutory threshold in USD or any other currency. The operative documentation obligation belongs to the foreign parent in its home jurisdiction: where the RMI BC is part of an OECD-aligned group, the parent must prepare Local File and Master File covering the RMI entity (typically triggered at EUR 1,000,000 or the local-law equivalent of related-party turnover) and, where applicable, a Country-by-Country Report at the EUR 750,000,000 consolidated revenue threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations comparable to those of the BVI or Cayman Islands. However, the RMI maintains commitments on transparency and exchange of information under its TIEA network and the OECD Harmful Tax Practices Framework. The board of the non-resident BC should nevertheless maintain credible substance: a valid RMI registered agent and office address, written minutes of board meetings, proper books and records, a bank account held in the entity's own name, and a clear commercial rationale for the RMI situs of the heparin-fractionation trading vehicle. The failure to maintain these elements is not an RMI statutory violation but will invite a foreign court to apply substance-over-form and recharacterize the BC as a sham.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the annual report and pay the franchise tax by 30 April, or continuing to transact after the Registrar of Corporations has revoked good standing or struck the corporation from the register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late-payment surcharge, suspension of the Certificate of Good Standing, administrative strike-off or revocation of the charter, and restoration only upon payment of all arrears, penalties, and reinstatement fees (31 MIRC, Business Corporations Act).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally named in restoration proceedings; contracts concluded after strike-off are voidable and directors may be held personally liable in contract or tort for trading through a defunct entity. Travel bans are not an RMI registry remedy but may be issued by the foreign forum enforcing a judgment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI BC as a paper conduit: all management decisions taken in a high-tax jurisdiction, no minutes, no accounting records, no registered-agent oversight, and no demonstrable function performed by the BC in the heparin procurement or fractionation chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI-side: strike-off for failure to maintain a registered agent. Foreign-side: a court may disregard the entity under substance-over-form or piercing doctrines, reallocate all income to the beneficial owner, and impose interest and punitive sanctions on the reallocated amounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution of reallocated income, disgorgement of profits, punitive damages, and personal liability for the BC's debts where the entity is found to be a mere instrumentality of the directors or shareholders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Foreign Tax Evasion and False Residency Claims
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring or implying to a foreign tax authority that the RMI BC is a tax resident of the RMI, claiming a TRC that does not exist, or booking dividends, royalties, or commissions into the BC without corresponding economic activity, thereby concealing taxable profits from the shareholder's home jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI-side: making a false statement to an RMI public officer is a criminal offence. Foreign-side: civil fraud penalties up to 75% of the understated tax (e.g., US IRC Section 6663), accuracy penalties of 20%-40%, criminal evasion fines, and incarceration for the responsible individuals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or direct the concealment face personal fines equal to the tax evaded, civil restitution, travel bans, extradition to the prosecuting State, and imprisonment (e.g., up to five years under US IRC Section 7201; analogous sanctions in EU Member States).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing letter-of-credit or SWIFT-wire settlements for heparin without completed beneficial-ownership KYC, accepting funds routed through third parties, operating an unlicensed money-services activity through the BC, or transacting with sanctions-listed counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018: for a natural person, a fine of up to USD 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 15 years; freezing and forfeiture of accounts; revocation of the registered agent's license for compliance failures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors acting as signatories or AML compliance officers are individually criminally liable for willful blindness to suspicious transactions; travel bans and passport seizure are available in extradition and mutual legal assistance proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Manufacturing, marketing, or distributing heparin sodium without the destination market's pharmaceutical authorization (e.g., US FDA, EU EMA), or using the BC to hold customer escrow funds or provide payment intermediation without an RMI banking or financial-services license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI Business License Act: fines and imprisonment for unlicensed business activity carried on in the RMI; foreign regulators may impose import bans, product detention, recalls, and civil money penalties for unauthorized APIs.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a non-compliant pharmaceutical supply chain face personal prosecution in the importing jurisdiction, including imprisonment of up to 20 years for adulteration or misbranding with intent to defraud (US FDCA analogues), plus civil restitution and debarment from government procurement.
